text:
zane: quick thought from the sandbox run: we need a hedging layer for prefetch failures. if try_pin is partially rejected we should issue a downgrade rather than outright drop.
maria: agree. proposal: MemoryScheduler.offer -> decision includes declines_allowed:int so scheduler can trim hint list. residency.try_pin returns pinned_count and a short reason enum.
kevin: important: add per-request max_prefetch_pages to avoid a single request consuming a tenant burst. default 8.
yara: fairness note: measure prefetch_win_rate_by_tenant and apply backpressure if a tenant's win_rate < global_median * 0.6. that reduces noisy-tenant amplification.
dmitri: implementation detail: make try_pin idempotent per-decision_id so retries don't double-count. also annotate pins with decision_id for traceability.
ops-bot: (ops-bot) saved: hedging-patterns-note pinned.
maria: small config snippet for defaults: 
  prefetch: { max_pages_per_req: 8, tenant_pool_pct: 0.12, global_emergency_pct: 0.6 }
zane: metrics to add: orbit.prefetch.partial_pin_rate, orbit.prefetch.clamp_reasons, orbit.prefetch.per_tenant_window_util.
kevin: test plan: chaos test where residency rejects 30% of pins and we verify no token P99 regression > 2x baseline.
yara: UX: show a per-request decision trace in console (sampled). include decision_id, attempted_pages, pinned_pages, reason. redact page ids.
dmitri: one more: ensure prefetch pins can be revoked quickly if eviction pressure spikes. residency manager should expose revoke(decision_id) and a hook for scheduler to react.
maria: agreed. that gives a clear contract: scheduler suggests, residency enforces, scheduler adapts.
zane: ok i'll add hedging to the prototype and update the smoke harness. will follow up with a tiny RFC blurb.
maria: thanks. leave comments here if you see edge cases. :thumbsup:
